elaine (sec-eng): Heads up — we're proposing a backwards-incompatible audit event change: remove actor.email, add actor.source_ip and request.id, and add a top-level audit_version header. Need migration plan + customer validation.

sam (infra): +1. Can you paste a minimal example of the new shape? Also, any KMS/RBAC impacts?

elaine (sec-eng): Sure — minimal example below. KMS: no change to event encryption, but the actor.identity materialization path touches RBAC mapping code (we'll need to ensure masking for service principals).
```json
{
  "audit_version": "2",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T17:02:00Z",
  "request": { "id": "req_12345", "route": "/v1/generate" },
  "actor": { "id": "user_abc", "type": "user", "source_ip": "198.51.100.23" },
  "action": "model.generate",
  "resource": { "model": "rw/ggml-1b" },
  "outcome": "success"
}
```

aisha (product): For customer-facing validators: do we have a compatibility shim that consumers can opt into? We should offer a small SDK snippet for validators.

elaine (sec-eng): Plan: 1) Introduce audit_version header in responses and emitted events (v2 opt-in). 2) Publish shim library + example. 3) Deprecate actor.email field (emit alongside for 30 days with WARNING tag). 4) Cutover after customers opt-in or after 8 weeks.

marc (cs): For customers on Dedicated/Private, what's the recommended validation path? We need to avoid surprises in compliance reports.

elaine (sec-eng): For Dedicated/Private, we'll provide a validation tool that runs against a sample log bundle and flags missing fields / mapping issues. We'll also coordinate with SEs for 1:1 sign-offs.

sam (infra): KMS/RBAC question: actor.email removal means we can't rely on email for principal mapping. Where will RBAC look up user attributes now?

elaine (sec-eng): RBAC will rely on actor.id (stable internal id) and an attribute cache that maps id -> email when available. For service principals, RBAC should use actor.type+id and consult the key registry. Ops: need a migration to seed the cache from our identity store.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: audit-schema/feature/audit-v2 at commit 9c3a4f. Build passed. :white_check_mark:

sam (infra): Can we add a runtime flag to preserve actor.email for private clusters for an extra 12 weeks? That'd help slow adopters.

elaine (sec-eng): Yes — add config: audit.allow_legacy_email: true/false. We'll default false in hosted, true in Private (with recommended timeline). Document in changelog.

aisha (product): Customer communication draft idea: "Audit event v2: stronger identity hygiene and explicit request ids — timeline and runbook". We'll run it by legal for wording around PII.

marc (cs): Create a short checklist for customers: how to validate, sample queries for SIEM, fallback indicators. I'll add CS playbook when you give me the sample queries.

elaine (sec-eng): Sample SIEM queries: (ELK) `exists(actor.email) AND audit_version:1` to find old events. Also `NOT exists(actor.email) AND audit_version:2` to find v2-only. I'll add a runnable script in the repo.

sam (infra): Migration runbook draft snippet:
```
1. Deploy v2 emitter behind feature flag
2. Run emitter in dual-write mode (emit both v1 & v2) for 2 weeks
3. Run validator tool across sampled logs; fix mapping gaps
4. Turn on v2-only for canary tenants
5. Gradual cutoff after validation & customer signoff
```

elaine (sec-eng): Risk notes: - Some customers ingest actor.email into DLP workflows; we'll flag those in the validator. - RBAC lookups must tolerate missing emails. - Ensure KMS wrapped keys unaffected.

aisha (product): Who owns the customer validator SDK + docs? I can own docs, need an eng owner for SDK.

sam (infra): I can own the SDK (small Python/JS validators). Will open a PR.

elaine (sec-eng): Cool. Action items: @sam open SDK PR with CLI validator, @marc draft CS checklist, @aisha draft comms and legal review, @sam + infra run the cache-seed plan, I'll own the rollout gating and postmortem if anything breaks.

marc (cs): Noted. I'll schedule a 1:1 with top 5 customers flagged by product.

elaine (sec-eng): Timeline proposal: announce today, dual-write in 2 weeks, validator available day 1 of dual-write, opt-in period 8 weeks, full cutoff 10 weeks unless exceptions.

sam (infra): One last q: metrics to watch?

elaine (sec-eng): Track: percentage of events with actor.email, # of validator failures per tenant, RBAC lookup errors, and KMS audit entries rate. Set alert if validator failures spike >5% baseline.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job: audit-v2-canary -> tenants: test-1,test-2,team-sandbox at 2026-03-29T03:00:00Z

marc (cs): OK — I'll prep customer-facing FAQ and a short troubleshooting guide for CS.

elaine (sec-eng): Thanks all. I'll create the GH issue with the runbook and assign tasks. Ping me in this thread for blockers. :pray:
